scheme_name: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Diploma)
other_conditions: Must be admitted to the first year of the Diploma level course or the second year through lateral entry in an AICTE‑approved institution.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹50,000 per year, up to 3 years for first‑year entrants and up to 2 years for lateral‑entry students.
documents_required: Valid income certificate issued by State/UT Government
